pages.title: A obra e a situação

work.title: Goodnight Moon
work.note: Goodnight Moon é um livro infantil escrito por Margaret Wise Brown e publicado em 1947 nos Estados Unidos. A obra dá contexto à missão linguística — “falar do sono: fall asleep (pegar no sono) e stay up (ficar acordado)”. A referência mostra a hora de dormir: fall asleep, stay up.

pages.title: Blue paper · 1/3
paragraphs: It is Saturday afternoon in a busy gift shop in Chicago. Shelves are full of mugs, books and candles. Marco walks slowly and looks at everything. He needs a birthday gift for his best friend. A shop assistant named Lia smiles at him. She asks if she can help.
“Hi! Can I help you find something?” says Lia. “Yes. I’m looking for a gift.” says Marco. “Who is it for?” says Lia.

pages.title: Blue paper · 3/3
paragraphs: “I’ll take both. Could you wrap them?” says Marco. “Of course. What color paper do you want?” says Lia. Marco pays twenty-two dollars for the mug and the book. Lia wraps them in blue paper with a white ribbon. She writes “Happy Birthday” on a small card. Marco signs the card and puts it on the box. That evening, Tom opens the gift and laughs. A thoughtful gift says more than words.
